samples.description: Event-grain completed U.S. common-stock SEOs issued in 1987–2006 after the paper’s SDC and Compustat screens. Each SDC deal remains a separate offering. Table 6 outcomes use year-1 matched ROA changes; controls are nonissuers matched on prior assets and closest year-0 ROA.

assumptions: The paper does not specify the event-to-fiscal-year mapping; use SDC issue calendar year as Compustat FYEAR year 0 and the next FYEAR as year 1.
The paper does not give the growth formula; use year-over-year percentage growth in SALE and CAPX with a positive, observed prior-year denominator.
The paper does not state the ROA matching period or tie rule; match on year-0 ROA and break exact ties by ascending GVKEY, allowing control reuse.
Use a constant in each Table 6 cross-section because the paper does not state its constant convention; omit the constant from the exported rows.

Match the SDC offer-date CUSIP to COMP.SEC_IDHIST CUSIP rows effective on that date, prefer exact nine-character matches, fall back to dated six-character matches, and exclude links that resolve to multiple GVKEYs. COMP.FUNDA.CUSIP is not treated as historical.

limitations: The paper does not specify the year-0 sales-growth or capex-growth formulas, Table 6 constant convention, ROA matching period, tie rule, or event-to-fiscal-year alignment; see design.md.

The local SDC schema lacks exact deal-category codes for several exclusions. Text-based description/business flags approximate rights and standby issues, units, funds and reverse LBOs; completion is proxied by an issue date with no postponed/withdrawn dates. The source sample has 1,511 offers; the final local sample is 2,070 event-grain offers from 1987–2006. The difference is not tuned away.

The source requires financial statements for four years before filing and data to calculate its DA/RM proxies. A2 operationalizes this as four consecutive latest pre-filing FYEAR labels and a common issuer year-0 sample with all six proxies; gaps and the shared metric screen are documented in design.md and review.md.

Dated SEC_IDHIST links select one GVKEY for 5,114 of 5,249 target SDC offers; 134 lack a dated Compustat link and one is ambiguous. Link coverage and residual event-count differences remain limitations.

Table 6 average adjusted R-squared is the equal-weighted mean of native annual OLS adjusted R-squared from the actual full-rank cross-sections, multiplied by 100 for the source percent units. The separate r2 row reports xtfmb average unadjusted R-squared as a fraction.
